title: 第1章  少爷我叫瘸猴第2章  永夜领主
content_zh:
剧痛从灵魂深处炸开，冰冷的空气刺痛着他的肺叶。
睁开眼，映入眼帘的不是医院惨白的天花板，也不是车祸后的人群混乱，而是一片无边无际的、死寂的灰褐色！
浑浊的天，龟裂的地。
零星几株枯黑的野草，以扭曲的姿势指向天空，狂风呜咽着掠过荒原卷起干燥的灰尘，充斥着一种死亡和铁锈混合在一起的荒野气味。
“这...这是哪？”
陈凡望向眼前陌生的一切，挣扎的从地面上坐起来，下意识想从裤兜里掏根烟出来，却发现自己原先的衣物都已不见，取而代之的是一件粗糙硌人的灰色布衣，兜里更没有什么香烟。
穿越？
他脑海里慢慢浮现出这个可能。
他能感受到自己此时身体极其虚弱，还有一些刺痛感，但他闭眼前可是被一辆横闯红灯的后八轮碾过去，伤势不可能这么轻。
就在这时——
耳边传来一道夹杂着哭腔的颤声：“少爷...你终于醒了！”
听见耳边的声音。
他下意识偏头望去，这才发现在这片一边无际的荒原上，除了他之外，还有一个同样身穿布衣骨瘦嶙峋的小厮，以及一间简陋的木屋和一团在熊熊燃烧的篝火。
下一刻！
刺痛猛烈传来，无数记忆碎片如灌肠般强行塞进他的脑海里，令他再次昏迷过去。
...
当他再次清醒过来时，已被刚才那个小厮搬至简陋木屋的板床上，而他也明白如今状况。
他穿越了。
这一世原身体主人同样名为陈凡，甚至连外貌和身体都完全一样，就像平行世界的另一世。
在这个世界黑夜降临后，会出现无数极其诡异的怪物取人性命，这种状况从数百年前就开始持续，世人将其命名为「永夜」。

只有呆在「诡火」附近，才能保证其安危。
诡火便是特殊制造的篝火堆。
在荒原上赶路要想保证自己的安全，就必须在夜黑前找到一处「站点」，只有站点才会拥有「诡火」。
打造「诡火」并不是一个简单的事情，「诡火」的底座极其笨重无法随身携带，且一旦熄灭底座便会自动损坏，想要保持诡火一直燃烧，需要不断投入「诡石」。
因此——
在城池外的荒原上，都有各个家族设下的不少「站点」，以此来保障来往商队和行人的安全，并收取对应的费用。
他所在的此处，便是「陈家」名下的一个站点。
只是...
他是被迫害来此的，身为陈家少爷的身份，却被安排了一个在荒原上看守站点这个危险度极高的工作，且临走前没有给他一枚「诡石」。
这也意味着！
当这团诡火熄灭之时，便是他的死亡之日。
前身主人受不了这种压力，气急攻心之下当场暴毙，也给了他重活一世的机会。
而身边这个小厮便是他的跟班。
“少爷。”
跪在床榻前骨瘦嶙峋的小厮顶着布满泪痕的脸颊，沙哑道：“奔波这么久，少爷你劳累了，我去守夜，少爷你安心睡。”
“...”
陈凡从床榻上挣扎着爬起来，推开木屋大门望向屋外那团篝火，根据他脑海里的记忆，这团诡火底部目前埋着三枚诡石，也就是说，最多还能燃烧三天。
三天后，这团诡火就会熄灭。
而这也是他的生命倒计时，这种情况下，他怎么可能还睡得着。
在荒郊野外，获取诡石唯一的方式，就是击杀诡物，从而从诡物身体内挖出诡石。

只是...
他身体虚弱，又赤手空拳，如何能杀的了诡物。
恍惚半晌后。
content_en:
Severe pain exploded from the depths of his soul, and the cold air stung his lungs.
When I opened my eyes, what I saw was not the pale ceiling of the hospital, nor the chaos of the crowd after the car accident, but the endless, dead gray-brown!
Turbid sky, cracked earth.
A few withered black weeds here and there pointed to the sky in twisted postures, and the strong wind whimpered across the wasteland, kicking up dry dust and filling it with a wilderness smell that was a mixture of death and rust.
"This...where is this?"
Chen Fan looked at the unfamiliar things in front of him, struggled to sit up from the ground, and subconsciously wanted to take out a cigarette from his trouser pocket, but found that his original clothes were gone, replaced by a rough gray cloth, and there were no cigarettes in his pocket.
Time travel?
The possibility slowly emerged in his mind.
He could feel that his body was extremely weak at this time, and there was still some tingling sensation, but before he closed his eyes, he was run over by the rear wheel of a car that ran through a red light. The injury could not be so minor.
Just then——
A trembling voice mixed with crying came to my ears: "Master... you finally woke up!"
Hear the voice in your ear.
He subconsciously turned his head and looked around, and then he discovered that in this endless wasteland, besides him, there was a skinny boy also wearing cloth, a simple wooden house and a blazing bonfire.
The next moment!
The stinging pain came violently, and countless memory fragments were forced into his mind like an enema, causing him to pass out again.
...
When he woke up again, he had been moved to the wooden bed in the simple wooden house by the boy just now, and he also understood the current situation.
He traveled through time.
The original owner of this body in this life was also named Chen Fan, and even his appearance and body were exactly the same, just like another life in a parallel world.
After darkness falls in this world, countless extremely weird monsters will appear and take human lives. This situation has continued hundreds of years ago, and the world has named it "Eternal Night."
Only by staying near the "strange fire" can its safety be guaranteed.
A strange fire is a specially made bonfire.
If you want to ensure your own safety while traveling in the wilderness, you must find a "station" before nightfall. Only stations will have "strange fire".
Creating a "crazy fire" is not a simple matter. The base of the "crazy fire" is too bulky to carry around, and the base will be automatically damaged once it is extinguished. If you want to keep the crafty fire burning, you need to continuously invest in "crazy rocks".
Therefore——
In the wasteland outside the city, there are many "stations" set up by various families to ensure the safety of caravans and pedestrians and collect corresponding fees.
The place where he is is a site under the name of "Chen Family".
Just...
He came here under persecution. As the young master of the Chen family, he was assigned a very dangerous job of guarding the station in the wasteland, and he was not given a "strange stone" before leaving.
This means too!
When this strange fire goes out, it will be the day of his death.
The previous owner couldn't bear the pressure and was so angry that he died on the spot, giving him a chance to live another life.
And the boy next to him is his follower.
"Master."
The skinny boy kneeling in front of the bed said hoarsely, "Master, you are tired after running around for so long. I will go and watch the night. Master, you can sleep peacefully."
"..."
Chen Fan struggled to get up from the bed, pushed open the door of the wooden house and looked at the bonfire outside the house. According to the memory in his mind, there were currently three strange stones buried at the bottom of this strange fire, which meant that it could burn for up to three days.
In three days, this strange fire will go out.
And this is also the countdown to his life. How can he still sleep under such circumstances?
In the wilderness, the only way to obtain treacherous rocks is to kill the treacherous objects, thereby extracting them from the treacherous objects' bodies.Dig out the rocks.
Just...
How could he kill the strange creature with his weak body and bare hands?
After being in a daze for a while.
